text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Win, win, win...! 
The one who wins is—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: It's meeeeeee!!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
(This intensity... this heat!
It feels like it's carving deep, deep into me——)

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...I won't give it up!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaah...!)

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: *Haa, fuu... haa*...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Fell short.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: (Besides... the problem is)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Man, that was thrilling!
What a great race!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
...I mean, did you see that girl's running—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Vodka.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Dammit...!
How uncool...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...Still, but still!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...Nngh, uooooooh!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: "It'd be way more uncool if I gave up here! I won't lose, I won't lose, next time I definitely won't lose!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Watch closely, everyone!
This is where the legend begins!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Vodka rushed into the underground tunnel.
Watching her back... were countless eyes, filled with feverish excitement.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
............
To be honest, I really wasn't expecting all that much.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Still, I might actually be looking forward to the next one...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I understand.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
......
What's with that face? You're the one who lost.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Nngh, so annoying!!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Even I...!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Change of plans.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Regarding our next race... In Chan's opinion,
I was thinking we take the royal road to the Oka Sho
with the Tulip Sho.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Still, the stone Vodka cast made a massive splash. The ripples have surely reached Scarlet as well.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Causality turns like a spinning wheel.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Then, just maybe, perhaps...
...Vodka too."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer, who do you think
will win between Scarlet and Vodka?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: It's the Tulip Sho.
choice_data_list: ...Did they say both of them would be running?
...Did they say both of them would be entering the race?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
No, not quite yet. Vodka is still at the stage
of deciding whether to aim for the Classic Triple Crown
or the Triple Tiara route.
choice_data_list: Then running in the Tulip Sho means—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Generally speaking, the Tulip Sho is a race
where many Umamusume aiming to run in the
Oka Sho tend to compete.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It is not yet certain we will appear.
However, I shall make it so.
And then, the two of us shall send high pillars of flame into the sky.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It's a pillar of fire that Chan couldn't raise alone.
Vivid and dramatic.
Everyone will look up at it in awe.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"And that is when Mar-chan makes her long-awaited entrance.
This is truly the grandest stage in full bloom."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: In other words, let's make the Fillies' Revue your next race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even more than usual, I had no idea what she was talking
about... but in her mind, it seemed to be a done deal.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan had always had a habit of tuning out
other people's opinions, for better or worse.
choice_data_list: (Even if I opposed it, she wouldn't listen anyway.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Besides, the Fillies' Revue is considered a trial race for the Oka Sho.
It's certainly not a bad choice.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The next race is the Fillies' Revue.
I made that decision while praying for the day
she might share her true feelings with me."
